critical.issue: Free-tier users are BLOCKED by production_security_policy_gate with 403 'Subscription Required — requires Basic plan or higher'. Root cause: /api/flappy-bird/ is NOT in access_control_engine.FREE_PATTERNS list, so get_required_level() returns default level 1 (basic). Feature 37 is category='entertainment' and the review request explicitly requires the free user to be able to submit scores for the multi-user leaderboard test. Sibling /api/games-station/ IS in FREE_PATTERNS (line 125). Fix: add r'^/api/flappy-bird/' to FREE_PATTERNS in /app/backend/utils/access_control_engine.py.

minor.issue: CSRF header enforcement observed weak: POST /score with same session cookies but WITHOUT X-CSRF-Token header returned 200 (accepted the write). Review request expected 403 CSRF_BLOCKED. Session had X-Requested-With header; unclear if that alone satisfies the middleware or if flappy-bird route is not covered by CSRF enforcement. Review production_security_policy_gate + CSRF middleware coverage for /api/flappy-bird/score.

Recommend main agent expose stable testids on the header theme+language switchers for repeatable E2E.

rca of the issue: FREE-USER 403: access_control_engine.get_required_level() falls through to `return 1` (basic) when path matches no pattern list. /api/flappy-bird/ is missing from FREE_PATTERNS (only sibling /api/games-station/ is present). production_security_policy_gate_middleware -> evaluate_policy_gate_decision -> evaluate_api_access reads that as 'basic required' and returns 403 subscription_required to any free user. Reproduction: login as p1.free.1779113329@example.com, GET /api/flappy-bird/bootstrap -> 403 with body {"error":"Subscription Required","required_plan":"basic","current_plan":"free"}. Fix (1-line): add r'^/api/flappy-bird/' entry to FREE_PATTERNS list in /app/backend/utils/access_control_engine.py alongside the r'^/api/games-station/' entry.
